cohort: 5,315 consecutive women who delivered (live births and stillbirths) at the University Hospital of Obstetrics and Gynecology "Koco Gliozheni" in Albania between January and May 2023, with a minimum gestational age of 28 weeks.
finding: Maternal age, gestational age, previous cesarean deliveries, fetal presentation, and number of fetuses were all significantly associated with the likelihood of both elective and non-elective cesarean sections.
